questions: Should the line numbers in the 'Line Number' column correspond to the original line numbers in the input files (starting from 1 for each file) or to the sequence numbers in the unified diff output (starting from 1 and incrementing across diff lines)?
When a line is present in only one file, which file's content should appear in the 'Content' column? The prompt says 'from either file' but does not specify which one for each status.
Should the function treat the CSV header row as a regular line for comparison, or should it be excluded from difference reporting?
What should happen if the two CSV files have different numbers of columns per row? Should the comparison still proceed line-by-line, or should it raise an error?
Should the 'Content' column display the raw line string (as read from the file) or the tuple representation after CSV parsing (e.g., "('Alice', '30')")?
If a line has internal commas or quotes, should the 'Content' column show the raw CSV line (with delimiters and quotechars) or the parsed fields concatenated?
Should the function ignore trailing whitespace (spaces/tabs) at the end of lines or within fields when comparing?
What should be the order of lines in the output DataFrame? Should it follow the sequence of the unified diff (interleaving lines from both files) or list all lines from file1 then file2?
